title: Psalms 30
summary: Cometh - Speedily and in due season.

inlines.v: Cometh - Speedily and in due season.
Mountain - My kingdom: kingdoms are usually called mountains in prophetical writings.
Profit - What wilt thou gain by it? The dust - Shall they that are dead celebrate thy goodness in the land of the living? Or, shall my dust praise thee?

Sackcloth - Given me occasion to put off that sackcloth, which they used to wear in times of mourning, Esth 4:1 Psal 35:13 Isa 32:11 Joel 1:13. Girded - With joy, as with a garment, surrounding me on every side.
